name: text
description: A paragraph of the product's shared text styles: the user's words (prose), a day's lede, an account screen's explanatory copy, a help or error line, and a quiet label. Typography only; where it sits is its parent's (data-place).

form.description: prose: the user's own words in an entry or recording (was .prose), --t-body serif in --ink. lede: a day's summary line on Timeline (was .lede), --t-note serif. copy: the explanatory sentence on an account or flow screen (was .auth-copy), --t-note serif in --rule. help: a help, error or status line (was .auth-help), --t-quiet label face in --rule-2. label: a voice memo's quiet label in place of a transcript (was .prose.audio-label), the label face at the prose line height.

chars.description: copy only: the measured character count of the authored sentence. When set, the sentence types itself in on arrival (the printed-line gesture, 820ms per 48 characters) inside the product shell's motion scope. Never set for user input.

exposes.--aj-c-text-chars: The authored copy's character count, written on its motion span by the render (chars): the typing steps and duration.

states.default: yes: as rendered; copy with chars types itself in on arrival
states.error: yes: the help form carries error lines (a refused value, a failed save) in its own colour

a11y.role: none: a paragraph (a status line takes role=status from its parent's markup)

responsive.1200: prose and lede lose any measure (max-width none)

changelog.change: New component (inventory 35): the shared text styles from lock.css (.prose, .lede, .auth-copy, .auth-help, .prose.audio-label) and the copy's typing motion.
